target_pattern: Use fixed sentence starters que yo sepa and que yo recuerde to express limited certainty naturally while using stable subjunctive chunk forms.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Responding with rigid certainty or pausing awkwardly when unsure.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish uses fixed hedging chunks to sound natural and fluent under uncertainty. These expressions are memorized as complete units.
target_pattern_formula: knowledge hedge: que yo sepa plus statement
memory hedge: que yo recuerde plus statement
both expressions contain fixed subjunctive forms
typical use is sentence-initial with pause
best practice is chunk memorization not word-by-word assembly
natural_examples: Que yo sepa, vive en Guadalajara.
Que yo recuerde, trabaja en el supermercado.
Que yo sepa, la reunion es a las diez.
Que yo recuerde, no hubo cambios.
Que yo sepa, el proyecto sigue activo.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Que yo sepa, vive en Guadalajara. -> change city to Monterrey.
Base: Que yo recuerde, trabaja en el supermercado. -> change workplace to una clinica.
Base: Que yo sepa, la reunion es a las diez. -> change time to las once.
Base: Que yo recuerde, no hubo cambios. -> change to affirmative si hubo cambios.
Base: Que yo sepa, el proyecto sigue activo. -> change noun to plan.
Base: Que yo sepa, no esta disponible hoy. -> change adverb to manana.
Base: Que yo recuerde, lo enviamos ayer. -> change day to el lunes.
Base: Que yo sepa, salen a las seis. -> change subject to singular el tren.
Base: Que yo recuerde, nos vimos en 2022. -> change year to 2023.
Base: Que yo sepa, no hay mas asientos. -> change noun to boletos.
Base: Que yo recuerde, cambiaron el horario. -> change object to la fecha.
Base: Que yo sepa, ella vive sola. -> change subject to plural ellos.
Base: Que yo recuerde, hablamos de eso la semana pasada. -> change time to ayer.
Base: Que yo sepa, el contrato es valido. -> change adjective to temporal.
Base: Que yo recuerde, nadie se quejo. -> change to plural pocas personas.

prompts: As far as I know. (Que yo sepa, vs Que yo se,)
As far as I remember. (Que yo recuerde, vs Que yo recuerdo,)
Soft uncertain answer. (Que yo sepa, no. vs Seguro que no.)
Memory-based hedge. (Que yo recuerde, fue el jueves. vs Que yo sepa, fue el jueves.)
Knowledge-based hedge. (Que yo sepa, abre a las nueve. vs Que yo recuerde, abre a las nueve.)
Fixed chunk form. (Que yo sepa vs Que yo saber)
Fixed chunk form. (Que yo recuerde vs Que yo recordar)
Natural conversational softener. (Que yo sepa, sigue abierto. vs Yo no tener claro, sigue abierto.)
Correct subjunctive chunk. (Que yo recuerde, no llamo. vs Que yo recuerdo, no llamo.)
Correct subjunctive chunk. (Que yo sepa, no hay problema. vs Que yo se, no hay problema.)

common_errors.mistake: Indicative used inside fixed chunk for saber
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use fixed form que yo sepa.

common_errors.mistake: Indicative used inside fixed chunk for recordar
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use fixed form que yo recuerde.

common_errors.mistake: Direct certainty used despite limited information
common_errors.correct_spanish: These chunks are native-like and pragmatic.

common_errors.mistake: Chunk order altered by word-by-word translation
common_errors.correct_spanish: Memorize and produce full chunk unchanged.

common_errors.mistake: Wrong chunk chosen for memory versus knowledge context
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use sepa for knowledge and recuerde for memory.

common_errors.mistake: Chunk treated as grammar drill only
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use in real answers to gain fluency.
Keep concise frame que yo sepa or que yo recuerde.
These expressions are safe fixed subjunctive chunks.

common_errors.mistake: Only one chunk used for every response
common_errors.correct_spanish: Alternate both forms based on context.
